scope: Initial Git source backup; does not certify media quality or stage acceptance
credential_scan: No common provider tokens, private-key blocks, credential query values, or literal JSON credentials detected in staged candidates; manual review identified an authorization description and runtime data-URL construction, not embedded credentials/media. Pattern scanning is not an absolute guarantee.
changed_document_link_checks: README.md and docs/GIT_BACKUP.md local links exist
source_requirement_documents: Original docx files retained; embedded figures inspected as project workflow diagram
remote_upload_status: Uploaded successfully; git push -u origin main exited 0 and git ls-remote matched local HEAD
behavior_tests: Not rerun: backup rules and documentation changed; application source behavior unchanged
excluded_runtime_data: Local original project files, database, teacher media and model environments retained; source backup requires separate controlled data backup for recovery
remote_metadata_check: GitHub connector verified visibility=private, default_branch=main and admin/push permissions; repository size can lag behind push, so commit identity was verified with ls-remote instead
git_authentication: User completed Git Credential Manager device authorization; credential stored by the credential manager, no token included in repository
push_network: Used existing local proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890 as a per-command git option; no global Git or system proxy changes
